guidance.claim: We remain on track to execute INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion capex over 5 years.
guidance.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years, which will further enhance our capabilities, scale and innovation.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Targeting a 30% dividend payout ratio by financial year 2030.
guidance.quote: This represents a step forward towards our Project Spring Polycab India Limited May 06, 2026 goal of achieving a 30% payout ratio by financial year 2030.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Aiming for greater than 10% revenue contribution from exports by FY 2030.
guidance.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Targeting 8% to 10% EBITDA margins in FMEG by FY2030.
guidance.quote: In FMEG, we are also progressing well consistently, outpacing industry growth in line with our target of growing at 1.5x to 2x of market rate, while maintaining a clear focus on margin expansion and progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Working capital cycle expected to revert to steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.
guidance.quote: On a normalized basis, we expect the working capital cycle to revert to our steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Long-term EBITDA margin expected at 11% to 13%, and near- to mid-term at 12% to 14%.
guidance.quote: So again, that's a very calibrated guidance which we have given that over long term, we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin. and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
guidance.horizon: near to mid term and long term
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Committed in Cables & Wires to grow at 1.5x of market growth.
guidance.quote: So again, Sonali, if you refer the Project Spring guidance, which also I referred during my speech, is that we've committed in Cables & Wires, we will grow at 1.5x of market growth.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Annual capex expected around INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion.
guidance.quote: During FY26, we incurred capex of INR 14.8 billion, in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: Consolidated revenue grew 27% year-on-year for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
reported.quote: For the quarter ended March 31, 2026, we are pleased to report a strong performance with consolidated revenue growing 27% year-on-year, driven by robust momentum in both cables and wires as well as FMEG segments.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 13.1%.
reported.quote: EBITDA for the quarter increased by 13% year-on-year with margins at 13.1% despite multiple industry headwinds and softer trade sentiment amid the ongoing Middle East escalation.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: Company delivered highest ever quarterly PAT of INR7.9 billion, up 7% year-on-year.
reported.quote: At the profit level, the company delivered its highest ever quarterly PAT of INR7.9 billion, reflecting a growth of 7% year -on-year.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 8.9%.
reported.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 8.9%.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: Full year revenue crossed INR 285 billion, growing 29% year-on-year.
reported.quote: Revenue crossed INR 285 billion milestone, growing 29% year -on-year.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.quote: So I think today also, our volume growth for the full year is 18% which is again industry leading.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
